lines.2: The blue sky stretched on forever.
lines.3: Who knew that just looking at the sky could make me feel this refreshed?
lines.4: Ever since Kinu and I had become a couple in every sense, life had gained a whole new spark.
lines.5: The school trip and cultural festival in autumn, and then winter--
lines.6: The rest of our school life promised to be busy.
lines.7: But with her, I knew I would enjoy it.
lines.8: 「Hey! What are you standing around for? Let's go.」
lines.11: 「I hurt my leg trying to run too hard.」
lines.12: 「Wow. You really are a wimp, Leo.」
lines.17: 「Walking with your arm around my shoulders like this kinda reminds me of a three-legged race.」
lines.18: 「Ha ha. We worked hard that time.」
lines.20: ...It was true. Sometimes I really was a wimp.
lines.21: And Kinu was, frankly, an idiot.
lines.22: Subaru had always looked after the two of us together.
lines.23: But if we kept walking together like a three-legged team, I felt we could overcome whatever hardships came next.
lines.26: 「You may be a wimp, but I love you.」
lines.28: And without a care for where we were--
